title: Mastcam-Z views the 'Cheyava Falls' workspace
caption: Cheyava Falls is the arrowhead-shaped rock on the left: drill hole where the Sapphire Canyon core was taken, white abrasion patch beside it. Use this to recognise the rock on arrival.

title: WATSON close-up of the 'leopard spots'
caption: Millimetre-size off-white spots with dark rims in the reddish part of the rock. This is what a 'spot' sample should look like up close.
